title: TD Storage Mac app: new folders, rename, move and trash from Finder
text: Version 0.2.8 of the TD Storage Mac app creates in the CRM a folder you paste into Finder; before, it stayed only on that Mac, and a repeated paste reuses the same folder. Version 0.2.9 lets you rename, move and Move to Trash from Finder: the change reaches the CRM, and a trash goes to the CRM trash, where it can be restored. This works in Business and My files; a client's folders are still changed only in the CRM.
points: Nothing is ever erased from Finder, and a fixed folder or a storage's top folder is never touched.
The Mac needs the new app version to get these.
Restoring from Finder's own Trash is done in the CRM.
